Summary of what I propose (drafted below for speed):

Proposed redline snippet for Exhibit B (language we can insert as new paragraph under "Fees & Credits"):
"
Ancillary Fee Waiver: Customer shall be eligible for an Ancillary Fee Waiver if, during any Billing Period, the aggregate credited token units from Reserved Burst Credits and On-Demand Autoscale Credits exceed 20% of Customer's billed token units for such Billing Period. "
